name: presby-site-kit
description: presby's shared public-site rendering shell: a versioned renderSiteBundle() entry point that presby imports directly, plus (in a later release) the fixed, allowlisted MDX component library congregation content repos author against. This v0.0.1-stub release exists only to make presby's Phase 4 render-path commit buildable and testable against a real npm-resolvable dependency, per DECISION-086 — it renders each page's front-matter title (if present) plus a placeholder, and does not parse or render mdxAst at all.
